StellarEntryPoint.description: Full type name of the entry point, or "default" for {AssemblyName}.EntryPoint

Assets.description: Files copied or embedded as they are. All lists are glob patterns relative to the project

Resources.description: Files compiled into the engine format

Compilers.description: Assemblies with additional resource compilers, relative to the project

Runtime.description: The settings of the runtime, and free-form values for modules: they reach RuntimeConfiguration.Settings. The command line (--stellar:Name=Value) wins over them

MainLoop.description: Whether the main loop runs. false: the engine stops as soon as the application has started

TargetFrameRate.description: Frames per second the main loop aims at, 0 for as fast as possible

MaxDeltaTime.description: The longest time step a frame reports, in seconds

MaxFrames.description: Stop after this many frames, 0 for never

FixedTimeStep.description: The fixed step of the engine clock, in seconds. 0: one fixed update per frame

MaxFixedSteps.description: The most fixed steps a participant runs in one frame

CollectibleModules.description: Whether the contexts of modules can be unloaded

ModuleInitializationParallelism.description: How many modules of one level start at once

Verbose.description: Whether the runtime tells every step on the error output
